case.story: I ordered a washing machine on Flipkart for Rs 23,490 on 2 October 2026. It arrived damaged, I returned it on 6 October and the refund status still says processing. Customer care keeps giving new dates. I have the order ID, invoice and screenshots.
evidence_mentioned: chat or email with customer care

questions: What is the current status shown in the refund portal?
Have you received any email or SMS confirming the refund processing?
Did you retain the courier receipt for the returned item?

result.markdown:
**What happened**
You bought a washing machine on Flipkart for ₹23,490 on 2 Oct 2026. It arrived damaged, you returned it on 6 Oct 2026 and the refund status still shows *processing* despite multiple promises from customer care.

**Where you stand**
- The transaction value is ₹23,490, which is well below the ₹50 lakh limit for the District Consumer Commission. [CP-FORUM]
- You have a cause of action (the undelivered refund) that arose on 6 Oct 2026, so you are within the two‑year filing window. [CP-LIMIT]
- The e‑commerce platform must have a Grievance Officer and must resolve complaints within one month. [CP-ECOM]

**What to do next**
1. **Raise a free grievance** with the National Consumer Helpline (1915 or 1800‑11‑4000, or consumerhelpline.gov.in). [CP-NCH]
2. If the issue is not resolved within 30 days of your complaint to the Grievance Officer, **file a consumer complaint** in the District Consumer Commission (no filing fee for claims up to ₹5 lakh). [CP-FEE]
3. File the complaint **online** via the e‑Jagriti portal (e‑jagriti.gov.in). [CP-EJAGRITI]

**What to collect**
- Order ID and invoice (you have).
- Screenshots of the refund‑status page and any chat/email with customer care (you have).
- Proof of payment (bank statement or payment receipt).
- Courier receipt or shipping proof for the returned item (if you can obtain it).
- Any email/SMS confirming the return or refund processing.

**When to get a real lawyer**
If the District Commission does not grant a refund or you face a complicated dispute (e.g., the platform refuses to acknowledge the grievance officer), consider contacting a lawyer or legal aid centre. Free legal aid is available through NALSA (call 15100). [LA-NALSA]

*This is general information, not legal advice.*

### When you need a real lawyer
- The other side replies through a lawyer, sends you a notice, or threatens you.
- You are near a time limit, or the amount is large for you.
- You are not sure the facts above are right. This is general information, not legal advice.
Free legal aid: call the NALSA helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority. Women and children are eligible whatever they earn; others qualify under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, for example by income. [LA-NALSA]

**Draft letter (edit before sending):**
```
Date: 21 November 2026
To: The Grievance Officer, Flipkart
Subject: Refund not received – Order [PLACEHOLDER]

I placed order [PLACEHOLDER] on 2 October 2026 and paid ₹23,490 by [PLACEHOLDER].
I returned the item on 6 October 2026, and the refund was promised by [PLACEHOLDER].
As of today the refund has not reached my account.

Please refund ₹23,490 to my original payment method within 7 days and confirm in writing.
If this is not resolved, I will register a grievance with the National Consumer Helpline and file a complaint before the District Consumer Commission.

[PLACEHOLDER] · [PLACEHOLDER]
Enclosed: invoice, payment proof, screenshots of the return/refund status
```

**Sources (checked 2026-11-21):**
- [CP-FORUM] https://theprint.in/economy/govt-notifies-new-rules-for-consumer-commissions-national-bodys-jurisdiction-enhanced/791753 · https://righttoinformation.wiki/how-to-file-consumer-forum-complaint-e-jagriti-dcdrc-india
- [CP-LIMIT] https://righttoinformation.wiki/edaakhil-online-consumer-commission-filing-india
- [CP-ECOM] https://fcainfoweb.nic.in/PMS/writereaddata/2021_LS_B_1317.pdf · https://thelaw.institute/consumer-protection-issues/e-commerce-consumer-rights-grievance-redressal
- [CP-NCH] https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/public/about · https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/e-commerce-leads-as-national-consumer-helpline-helps-recover-45-crore-in-refunds-across-31-sectors
- [CP-FEE] https://righttoinformation.wiki/how-to-file-consumer-forum-complaint-e-jagriti-dcdrc-india
- [CP-EJAGRITI] https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/2996292/1/AU4546_s9hvb0.pdf · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E-Jagriti
- [LA-NALSA] https://nalsa.gov.in/legal-services/ · https://nalsa.gov.in/services/legal-aid/eligibility?locale=ma
